## What

One concern per PR. Link the roadmap line or issue this serves.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (count: ___ — update if it changed)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes

## Trust checklist (delete what doesn't apply)

- [ ] Run-affecting change preserves cost receipts (`tokens / model mix / $`)
- [ ] No policy/audit/memory schema change (or a recorded ruling is linked)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or a one-paragraph justification is included)
- [ ] README updated (commands, flags, or behavior changed)
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
